title: Deictic Shifts: Pronouns, Persons & Temporal Adverbs

sections.title: Shifting Point of View
sections.content: While tense remains unchanged in Hungarian indirect speech, personal pronouns, verb inflection persons, and spatial-temporal deictic adverbs shift to reflect the reporter's perspective (*én -> ő*, *itt -> ott*, *ma -> aznap*, *holnap -> másnap*).

items.spanish: „Itt várok rád” -> Azt mondta, hogy ott vár rám.
items.english: 'I wait for you here' -> He said that he was waiting for me there.

items.spanish: „Ma nem érek rá” -> Azt mondta, hogy aznap nem ér rá.
items.english: 'I don't have time today' -> He said that he didn't have time that day.

items.spanish: „Segítünk nektek” -> Azt mondták, hogy segítenek nekünk.
items.english: 'We help you' -> They said that they would help us.
